source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 20 September 1946, p. 3 ("Nominations for County and Rural Councils") ("Lurgan")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1946: eight nominations for six divisions and none for the other four. Cornakinnegar (J. News and R. J. Brown) and Portadown Rural (J. H. Walsh, sitting member, and H. R. Gray) were contested on 3 October 1946; the results were not found (Walsh was re-elected chairman of the council a week later: Belfast Telegraph, 10 October 1946, p. 5). Returned unopposed.
